fields.name: live_checksum
fields.meaning: Check word of the live game state, recomputed just before the state is copied to a slot
fields.evidence: code f000:1832-183c; only bytes 0x0000-0x0001 change in live area on save

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: ASCII text "Graduation". Checked at every power-on: if missing, the whole 32 KB is erased. Also written when a new game starts
fields.evidence: code f000:1a56-1a73 (compare + wipe), f000:1930-193e (write); boot reads bytes 0x0002-0x000B at f000:1a61

fields.name: live_state
fields.meaning: Live game state used while playing (same layout as a slot from +0x00C). Cleared when a new game starts; overwritten when a slot is loaded; not resumed by itself at power-on, so only the four slots are real saves
fields.evidence: code f000:18a7 (clear + init), f000:185e (load copies slot here); filled at new game

fields.name: unused_gap
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero (first byte is the last checksum byte, always 0)
fields.evidence: always 0 in every observed image

fields.name: slot_1
fields.meaning: Save slot 1 of 4. Slot n (1-4) starts at 0x0573 + (n-1)*0x800 and is a byte-for-byte copy of live state 0x0000-0x056D. Rows below give offsets for slot 1; add 0x800 per further slot
fields.evidence: code f000:1832 (save copy), f000:185e (load copy), f000:4ae7 (check); natural saves observed in slots 1, 2 and 3

fields.name: unused_after_slot_1
fields.meaning: Gap after each slot (slot end to next slot start); never written, stays zero. Same gap after slots 2-4
fields.evidence: always zero; copy length 0x56E in f000:1832

fields.name: slot_2
fields.meaning: Save slot 2 (same layout as slot 1)
fields.evidence: natural save into slot 2; code f000:1832

fields.name: slot_3
fields.meaning: Save slot 3 (same layout as slot 1)
fields.evidence: natural save into slot 3 (checksum verified); code f000:1832

fields.name: slot_4
fields.meaning: Save slot 4 (same layout); ends at 0x22E0
fields.evidence: code f000:1832 address formula; empty in all observed saves

fields.name: slot.checksum
fields.meaning: Slot check value: 1 + the sum of the bytes from slot+0x002 up to slot+0x56E (0x56D bytes; the last byte lies just past the slot copy and is always 0), kept to 16 bits. A slot whose value does not match is listed as unused
fields.evidence: code f000:188b (sum), f000:4ae7 (compare), f000:4a26-4a2b (unused branch); recomputed on 4 natural saves (0x4244, 0x429C)

fields.name: slot.signature
fields.meaning: Copy of the "Graduation" text (not checked on load)
fields.evidence: slot 1 contents; copy f000:1832

fields.name: slot.people
fields.meaning: Six person records of 0x40 bytes: record 0 = the teacher (player) at slot+0x00C, records 1-5 = the five students at slot+0x04C + (k-1)*0x40. Rows below give each field at record offsets +field; same layout in every record
fields.evidence: code f000:1904-191e (pointer table), f000:52eb (status panel indexes records 0-5); template f000:1c02

fields.name: person.flags
fields.meaning: Status bit flags for this person (bit 0 set / bit 1 cleared by the daily routine, bit 5 cleared when an event ends, bit 7 skips the daily cycle) (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x00)
fields.evidence: code f000:6ae6 (set bit 0), f000:0d00/0d05 (clear bit 5), f000:696d (test bit 7)

fields.name: person.basic
fields.meaning: Basic study score x10; screen shows value/10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x02)
fields.evidence: code f000:5372 status panel; matches student stat screen

fields.name: person.applied
fields.meaning: Applied study score x10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x04)
fields.evidence: code f000:537f; screen applied 32 = 324/10

fields.name: person.memory
fields.meaning: Memory score x10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x06)
fields.evidence: code f000:5399; screen memory 35 = 350/10

fields.name: person.languages
fields.meaning: Languages score x10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x08)
fields.evidence: code f000:538c; screen languages 12 = 125/10

fields.name: person.popularity
fields.meaning: Popularity (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x0A)
fields.evidence: code f000:534b; screen popularity 85

fields.name: person.refinement
fields.meaning: Refinement x10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x0C)
fields.evidence: code f000:5358; screen refinement 38 = 380/10

fields.name: person.stamina
fields.meaning: Stamina; students x10, teacher as shown (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x0E)
fields.evidence: code f000:533e, f000:53cf; teacher 40 on screen, student 50 = 500/10; new-game init f000:18ec

fields.name: person.hp
fields.meaning: HP (strength left); goes down with activities (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x10)
fields.evidence: code f000:5331; screens show 40/48/22; falls during play

fields.name: person.charm
fields.meaning: Charm; students x10, teacher as shown (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x12)
fields.evidence: code f000:5365, f000:53e9; teacher 60 on screen, student 73 = 730/10

fields.name: person.hidden_a
fields.meaning: Hidden stat (starts 20-90 per student, changes in play). Compared against 80/90 for event checks and squared into the daily random-event chance (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x14)
fields.evidence: code f000:0778/08ad/08c6 (thresholds), f000:6ad1 (chance calc); diffs across play

fields.name: person.hidden_b
fields.meaning: Hidden stat (starts 20-60 per student, changes in play). Checked against 80 for event checks (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x16)
fields.evidence: code f000:08cc (threshold), f000:6c1b (date-gated read); diffs across play

fields.name: person.partner_a
fields.meaning: Partner student number 1-5 (0 = none); constant per student (4,1,2,5,3). Used as a schedule-table index when checking activities (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x18)
fields.evidence: code f000:67df (schedule index); never changes in play

fields.name: person.partner_b
fields.meaning: Second partner student number; always 0 in observed saves but read as a schedule-table index the same way (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x1A)
fields.evidence: code f000:67b7 (schedule index); always 0

fields.name: person.cycle_strength
fields.meaning: Per-student constant used by the 29-day cycle: subtracted from the condition value near the end of the cycle and added back twice at its start (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x1C)

fields.name: person.student_no
fields.meaning: Student number 1-5 (0 for the teacher); used as an index into the schedule table; never changes (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x1E)
fields.evidence: code f000:6793 (schedule index); never changes

fields.name: person.cycle_day
fields.meaning: 29-day cycle countdown; reset to 29 when it reaches 0 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x20)
fields.evidence: code f000:6987-698c; changes daily

fields.name: person.rating
fields.meaning: Rating. For the teacher record it is the class total: the sum of the five students ratings, capped at 999 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x22)
fields.evidence: code f000:52f5-5310 (teacher total), f000:5324/53a8 status panel; screens show 500/364; recomputed 51+58+39+103+30=281

fields.name: person.rest_timer
fields.meaning: Rest/recovery countdown: set to 10 plus a random 0-31, then counts down to 0 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x24)
fields.evidence: code f000:6c70-6c79 (set), f000:6d11/0f0d (decrement); 0 in most states

fields.name: person.condition
fields.meaning: Condition value moved by the 29-day cycle and by events (for example +5, reset to 51 or 0); screen label not identified (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x26)

fields.name: person.event_id
fields.meaning: Pending event id (0 = none). When its timer runs out the event message plays and rating drops by 10 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x28)
fields.evidence: code f000:08e3 (set), f000:0904 (clear), f000:08f7-090e (fire, rating -10)

fields.name: person.event_timer
fields.meaning: Event countdown, set to 60 and ticking down; the pending event fires at 0 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x2A)
fields.evidence: code f000:08e6 (set 60), f000:08eb (tick); falls between saves (49->36 etc.)

fields.name: person.activity_count
fields.meaning: Activity attempt counter, raised once per activity check (in the teacher record it holds the focused student number instead) (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x2C)
fields.evidence: code f000:6741 (increment), f000:6b0d/6c4f (thresholds), f000:6736 (teacher use)

fields.name: person.activity_result
fields.meaning: Activity check result: 1 = waiting, 0 = match/ok, 2 = mismatch (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x2E)

fields.name: person.activity
fields.meaning: Current activity code, low byte; compared against the schedule entries (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x30)
fields.evidence: code f000:6744 (store), f000:67a9 (compare), f000:6d59 (>=9 branch)

fields.name: person.reserved_32
fields.meaning: Always 0; no code reads or writes it (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x32)
fields.evidence: always 0 in every state; no references in code

fields.name: person.contest_points
fields.meaning: Contest/exam points: +10 on one outcome, -10 on the other (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x34)

fields.name: person.round_score
fields.meaning: Round score computed as activity/2 minus a random 0-63, minimum 0 (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x36)
fields.evidence: code f000:153f-1554 (compute + store), f000:1580 (compare)

fields.name: person.money
fields.meaning: Teacher only: money left. On the 1st of every month wealth is added to it (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x38)
fields.evidence: code f000:53c2 status panel, f000:11ff-1210 (monthly add); screens show 100/400/500; new-game init 100

fields.name: person.intellect
fields.meaning: Teacher only: intellect (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x3A)
fields.evidence: code f000:5403; screen 50; init f000:18f8

fields.name: person.wealth
fields.meaning: Teacher only: wealth (monthly income added to money) (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x3C)
fields.evidence: code f000:53dc, f000:120d; screen 100; init f000:18da

fields.name: person.persuasion
fields.meaning: Teacher only: persuasion (record r at slot+0x00C+r*0x40, field +0x3E)
fields.evidence: code f000:53f6; screen 50; init f000:18f2

fields.name: slot.people_before
fields.meaning: Copy of the six person records taken at the start of the current period; the status panel compares current values against it to show how much each value changed
fields.evidence: code f000:0638 (copy 0x00C->0x18C), f000:5327.. (reads +0x180); mirrors live records with a delay

fields.name: slot.record_table
fields.meaning: Six offsets of the person records (0x000C,0x004C,...,0x014C); constant

fields.name: slot.day
fields.meaning: Day of month of the current date
fields.evidence: code f000:1922 (new game: 8), f000:4a9f (slot list); slot list shows 9月 1日

fields.name: slot.month
fields.meaning: Month of the current date (game starts April 8)
fields.evidence: code f000:1922, f000:4a93; April at start, September in late save

fields.name: slot.weekday
fields.meaning: Day of week, 0 = Sunday
fields.evidence: code f000:1929 (init 1), f000:04f2, f000:696d (+1/day mod 7); Sunday shown with 0

fields.name: slot.event_today
fields.meaning: School event code for today from the calendar table (0 = ordinary day)

fields.name: slot.event_tomorrow
fields.meaning: Event code for tomorrow

fields.name: slot.event_day_after
fields.meaning: Event code for the day after tomorrow

fields.name: slot.cursor_index
fields.meaning: Menu cursor position; reused as the student loop index 1-5 while days are processed
fields.evidence: changes with cursor moves; code f000:05e5, f000:696d/1536/6a1c (loop 1..5, reset to 1)

fields.name: slot.selected_student
fields.meaning: Selected student / event target (values 0-2 observed); read together with the student index
fields.evidence: code f000:0552, f000:05ba/0c4e/0e75/0f28; 0 early, 1-2 later

fields.name: slot.unused_321
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in all observed states
fields.evidence: always 0

fields.name: slot.day_step
fields.meaning: Counter of steps processed in the current schedule run; reset when a new schedule run starts
fields.evidence: code f000:0950 (reset), f000:05ef/060c (increment)

fields.name: slot.schedule
fields.meaning: Schedule codes being planned (15 bytes = 5 students x 3)
fields.evidence: code f000:0964-0967 (pointer start), f000:6793 (student_no index); changes on the schedule screen

fields.name: slot.schedule_ptr
fields.meaning: Pointer to the current entry in the schedule (0x032A-0x0339)
fields.evidence: code f000:0967; values 0x032A..0x0339 in saves

fields.name: slot.schedule_confirmed
fields.meaning: Second copy of the schedule codes (confirmed schedule)
fields.evidence: code f000:0999, f000:09f1; differs from schedule while planning

fields.name: slot.music
fields.meaning: Background music number to play for the main screen

fields.name: slot.random_index
fields.meaning: Random-number position; advanced every frame and on every random draw
fields.evidence: code f000:25a8, f000:26f1; changes in nearly every state

fields.name: slot.teacher_type
fields.meaning: Teacher type chosen at the start (1 = rich type); shown on the save/load list
fields.evidence: code f000:4d66 (set from menu), f000:4a6c (slot list text), f000:169f; shown on screens

fields.name: slot.const_5
fields.meaning: Always 5 (set together with the next word at game start); meaning unknown
fields.evidence: code f000:02c6; always 5

fields.name: slot.const_4
fields.meaning: Always 4; meaning unknown
fields.evidence: code f000:02c6; always 4

fields.name: slot.student_marks
fields.meaning: One byte per student, cleared at the start of a run and copied to working memory

fields.name: slot.flag_358
fields.meaning: Flag byte, always 0 observed
fields.evidence: code f000:09d2 (test), f000:1269 (set); always 0

fields.name: slot.scene
fields.meaning: Current scene/mode number (compared with 3; saved and restored around events)
fields.evidence: code f000:135d, f000:1635, f000:46de; always 2 in saves

fields.name: slot.play_number
fields.meaning: Playthrough number shown as "N回目" on the save/load list; copied from the new-game counter when a game starts
fields.evidence: code f000:00a7-00ae, f000:4aa9; list shows 1回目

fields.name: slot.unused_tail
fields.meaning: Rest of the slot; always zero (part of the copied block)
fields.evidence: always zero; code copy length 0x56E

fields.name: unused_after_slots
fields.meaning: Not used (after slot 4 up to the collection flags); stays zero
fields.evidence: always zero

fields.name: boot_flags
fields.meaning: Working flags, reset at every power-on; not save data
fields.evidence: code f000:1a7b (reset at boot), f000:1a1a

fields.name: gallery_flags
fields.meaning: Collection unlock flags kept across all games and slots (four pages). Bits are set during play and shown by a picture/collection screen
fields.evidence: code f000:40dc-40f4, 40fa-4112, 4117-4121, 4126-414e (set), f000:3ab7-3b5b (display); bits accumulate across play

fields.name: newgame_counter
fields.meaning: Number of games started; incremented at every new game and copied into the slot as the playthrough number
fields.evidence: code f000:00a7-00ae; becomes 1 at first new game

fields.name: sound_scratch
fields.meaning: Six words preserved across sound-effect calls; always 0 in saves
fields.evidence: code f000:82a9 (save/restore around f000:8329); always 0

fields.name: working_memory
fields.meaning: Working memory used while running (changes every frame); not save data, though it is only cleared by the full erase
fields.evidence: regions change constantly; not read by load code

fields.name: unused_ieep
fields.meaning: The console internal EEPROM is not used by this game; identical in every observed state
fields.evidence: byte-identical across all states
